description: This Java source file defines the class `TableFrame`, a GUI component extending `JInternalFrame`. It manages a table display within a Swing-based application for the RomRaider project, providing functionalities such as registration, deregistration, property display, comparison, and interaction with other components like editor and menu bar.

classes.name: TableFrame
classes.description: A Swing internal frame that displays and manages a Table object within the RomRaider application. Handles user interactions including table registration, deregistration, property viewing, and comparison operations.

methods.name: TableFrame
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TableFrame with a specified title and table.

methods.name: internalFrameActivated
methods.description: Updates toolbar and menu states when the frame becomes active.

methods.name: internalFrameOpened
methods.description: Registers the table when the internal frame is opened.

methods.name: internalFrameClosing
methods.description: Deregisters the table when the internal frame is closing.

methods.name: internalFrameClosed
methods.description: Updates toolbar when the frame is closed.

methods.name: internalFrameIconified
methods.description: Placeholder for iconify event; no specific implementation.

methods.name: internalFrameDeiconified
methods.description: Placeholder for de-iconify event; no specific implementation.

methods.name: internalFrameDeactivated
methods.description: Updates toolbar when the frame is deactivated.

methods.name: RegisterTable
methods.description: Registers the table with the TableUpdateHandler.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns the table managed by this frame.

methods.name: getTableMenuBar
methods.description: Returns the menu bar associated with this table frame.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles menu actions such as undo, revert, copy, compare, interpolation, and table management.

methods.name: compareByTable
methods.description: Sets a selected table for comparison and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: refreshSimilarOpenTables
methods.description: Refreshes the list of similar open tables in the menu.

methods.name: findSimilarTable
methods.description: Finds a table matching a given menu item, used for comparison purposes.
